description:
About the job

To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Customer Success team within Signature Success is looking for a driven and customer-focused Customer Success Manager (CSM) to serve as a primary contact point for Salesforce’s largest and highest-profile customers. You will have responsibility for partnering with a small number of assigned accounts, maintaining a continual focus on the customer’s business goals to improve their overall technical and operational health and realize the maximum value out of their Salesforce investment. The Customer Success Manager maintains awareness of the customer's key events, needs, potential risks, and value drivers.

As a trusted advisor, the CSM will build a track record in customer success through superb communication with partners and extensive knowledge of the Salesforce platform to translate their business needs to solutions. You will forge relationships with your customers and account teams, develop a deep technical understanding of their Salesforce implementation, share standard methodologies, and adoption of proactive services. These activities will enable you to proactively set the customer up for success through optimization of the platform, with special care during critically important peak events.

As a CSM, you will occasionally act as a point of contact for any major incidents, owning the customer’s expectations and communications through the resolution of such incidents. The CSM acts as the technical main interface on behalf of our customers and works closely across both internal and external collaborators, including partners and ISVs, as required to address the customer needs.

The ideal CSM has an extraordinary focus on the success of the customer, is an exceptional communicator, exhibits professionalism, is dedicated to meeting and exceeding expectations, enjoys forming relationships, has excellent collaboration skills, and has the ability to learn new technologies quickly.

Your Impact


Function as the Marketing Cloud Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the technical and operational configuration (and needs) of the customer.
Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for orchestration of all Signature deliverables, experience, and renewal, and expansion.
Cultivate and maintain stakeholder relationships with the customer’s IT and business executive leadership, sponsors, and decision-makers within customer organizations that have purchased Signature.
Help your customers achieve their business goals and outcomes on the Salesforce Marketing platform by:
Coordinating the completion of the Signature Success catalog of services as required for your customer
Providing timely, proactive Salesforce feature guidance based on the areas of interest for your customer
Acting as an advisor to your customers for the adoption of new features of Salesforce’s annual release schedules and identifying potential challenges and risks to your customer's implementation
Communicate the value of Signature Success. Be accountable for ensuring all collaborators understand this value so that customers continue to renew Signature Success.
Act as an advocate for customers during the triage and resolution of high severity cases to assist with the timely resolution of these issues.
Proactive Support & Enhancement: Conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
Internal Relationship Building: Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
The CSM may be required to occasionally be available for some after-hour or weekend coverage depending on the customer’s need.
Evolution of Roles: Anticipate and adapt to role changes per evolving Salesforce needs.

Minimum Skills


Experienced professional with 5+ years of relevant industry expertise in Technical Customer Success, Customer Success Manager, SaaS platform use or project leadership, Technology Consulting, Technology Solutions Development, Technical and/or Solutions Architecture.
Exceptional communication and presentation skills with demonstrated ability to communicate and influence effectively at all levels of the organization, including executive and C-level.
Skills for both analyzing technical concepts and translating them into business terms and for mapping business requirements into technical features.
Ability to explain complex technical concepts in business-friendly terms to customers, then explain customer needs to internal partners.
Coordinate and work closely with high volume events and/or key events for the customer.
Experience leading efforts of cross-functional teams to facilitate resolution or disposition of customer needs or projects.


Preferred Requirements


+2 years in Salesforce Ecosystem.
Salesforce product certifications are a plus (Marketing Associate, Marketing Cloud Administrator, Salesforce Certified Associate, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement Specialist, Marketing Cloud Email Specialist).
Deep understanding of Marketing Cloud, marketing automation, personalization, advertising, and/or marketing platforms.
Deep understanding of Digital Marketing processes, challenges and trends
Knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud features and applications and able to articulate the value and how a Customer can benefit from Signature Success for Marketing Cloud
Knowledge of Salesforce product suite and features, capabilities, best use, and how to deploy, including knowledge of the Salesforce platform and ecosystem.
Degree or equivalent experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the strengths you'll need for the role (e.g. demonstrated behaviors in previous jobs, that align to role needs such as extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)


This position will require you to work from your local Salesforce office 3 to 4 days a week.

Volunteer Opportunities

Have you heard of our 1:1:1 model, focused on giving back to the community? The success in giving back has helped us and our Trailblazer community become a leader in philanthropy, culture, and innovation. We are one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies, according to Forbes, we are #1 in PEOPLE’s Top 15 Companies that Care, and are on Fortune’s Change the World list. Values create value. Our values helped drive our revenue number to $13.28 billion dollars in fiscal years in 2019.

We have a public-facing website that explains our various benefits for:


Health benefits

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. description:
About the job

All candidates from LATAM countries are welcome to apply!!!




As a CRO / Website Optimization Specialist, you will own a client's website and quiz-funnel experimentation roadmap from opportunity identification through execution and analysis. This is not a strategy-only position: you will formulate hypotheses, build and launch tests yourself, analyze performance, and determine what should happen next.

You'll have meaningful autonomy across Shopify, landing pages, quizzes, cart optimization, analytics, and experimentation tools. The right person combines strong CRO judgment with the technical confidence to make changes independently without relying on the client to finish or troubleshoot the execution.

Working hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST.




Responsibilities

Own the website and quiz-funnel experimentation roadmap, prioritizing opportunities based on customer behavior, data, and potential conversion impact.
Turn conversion opportunities into clear hypotheses with defined success metrics and a rationale for why each test is worth running.
Personally build, QA, and launch A/B tests using Intelligems or comparable experimentation platforms.
Make Shopify front-end changes independently, including landing page updates, merchandising improvements, UX changes, and conversion-focused site enhancements.
Build and optimize landing pages rather than relying solely on designers or developers to execute your recommendations.
Improve quizzes and personalization funnels using Digioh or comparable tools to increase engagement and progression through the purchase journey.
Optimize cart and upsell experiences using Rebuy, Smart Cart, or similar Shopify conversion tools.
Use GA4 and platform-level analytics to evaluate website behavior, conversion performance, event tracking, and experiment outcomes.
Translate experiment results into clear next steps, including follow-up tests, rollouts, iterations, or changes in roadmap priority.
Troubleshoot unfamiliar website and platform issues independently using documentation, support resources, AI tools, and structured problem-solving.




Requirements

Must-Have:

3-6+ years of hands-on experience in CRO, e-commerce website optimization, growth, or a closely related role, with flexibility for candidates whose experience demonstrates equivalent depth.
Strong practical knowledge of e-commerce conversion optimization, including funnels, customer journeys, merchandising, UX, and key conversion levers.
Hands-on Shopify front-end experience with the ability to make and troubleshoot website changes independently.
Proven ownership of A/B testing from opportunity identification and hypothesis creation through implementation, analysis, and next-step recommendations.
Hands-on experience with Intelligems or a comparable experimentation platform, plus working knowledge of GA4 and website conversion analytics.
Ability to personally build landing pages and conversion experiences rather than only producing briefs for designers or developers.
Strong judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to follow detailed written or video instructions carefully when working with sensitive website or company information.




Nice to Have:

Experience using Digioh for quizzes, funnels, personalization, or comparable conversion experiences.
Experience with Rebuy, Smart Cart, or similar Shopify upsell and cart-optimization tools.
Direct experience working with DTC e-commerce brands.
Experience optimizing subscription-based e-commerce businesses.
Previous experience in a role that combined strategic CRO ownership with substantial hands-on execution.

Ahora, contamos con más de 25 años de trayectoria, oficinas en España y México, y un equipo de más de 300 personas que hacen posible todo esto. 23 de ellas llevan más de 10 años trabajando juntas y 25 decidieron volver al equipo tras un tiempo fuera.

About the job

A LITTLE BIT ABOUT Boldr

Boldr is the first global B-Corp dedicated to delivering world-class Client experiences while creating access to dignified, meaningful work in communities around the world
We are a global team, united by our desire to connect diverse people with common values for boldr impact. 


LET'S START WITH OUR VALUES

Meaningful connections start with AUTHENTICITY
We do our best work by being CURIOUS
We grow by remaining DYNAMIC
Our success combines AMBITIOUS VISION with OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE 
At the heart of great partnerships we'll always find EMPATHY


WHAT IS YOUR ROLE

As a Senior Customer Sales Advocate, you'll embody the determined spirit that characterizes our team. With unwavering confidence, you will proactively engage with prospective customers and guide them through their decision-making journey, working towards converting interest into confirmed customers. Your ability to communicate value clearly and handle multiple conversations with precision will directly contribute to conversion success.

This role blends elements of sales, customer experience, and operational execution. You will manage inbound conversations, follow up with prospects in a structured way, and help ensure a smooth and responsive experience throughout the acquisition journey.


WHY DO WE WANT YOU

We are currently looking for impact-driven individuals who are passionate in helping Boldr grow and achieve our Purpose. We expect our Team to become our ultimate partners to success by always giving their 110% in everything, sharing their talents and quirks, and championing our core values: Curious, Dynamic and Authentic.


WHAT WILL YOU DO

Understand the products inside and out and articulate our value proposition clearly
Conduct system demos to potential clients
Own inbound customer conversations from initial inquiry through conversion, delivering fast, thoughtful, and high-quality responses via chat, email, SMS, and phone
Proactively follow up with leads using structured, multi-touch outreach to re-engage prospects and reduce drop-off
Identify and prioritize high-intent opportunities to focus effort where it drives the most conversion impact
Understand the product offering deeply and clearly articulate value propositions to prospective customers

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

About The Team/role

We are looking for an Online Media Manager that owns the planning, supports execution, optimization and measurement of digital media campaigns across our business.

This role will translate campaign briefs and business objectives into actionable digital media plans, working closely with Channel Managers, Marketing teams, Creative teams, Analytics and our media agency.

You will be responsible for ensuring campaigns are properly planned, implemented, monitored and optimized, while turning campaign performance into clear insights and learnings that can improve future media decisions.

We are looking for someone who combines strong digital media fundamentals, is curious about integrated media planning, with analytical thinking, attention to detail and curiosity about how media contributes to marketing and business outcomes.

In this role, you'll be...

Digital Media Planning


Translate campaign briefs and marketing objectives into actionable digital media plans.
Support the development of audience, channel, format and investment recommendations based on campaign objectives.
Work with Senior Media Managers and Channel Managers to ensure media plans follow the overall media strategy and channel best practices.
Integrate relevant business, market, audience and historical campaign learnings into media recommendations.
Ensure digital media planning is connected with the broader integrated campaign and other relevant media channels.



Campaign Execution


Coordinate campaign setup and implementation with media agencies, Channel Managers and internal stakeholders.
Validate that audiences, formats, placements, creative assets, tracking and campaign parameters are correctly implemented before launch.
Coordinate creative asset requirements and ensure media specifications and deadlines are met.
Maintain visibility of campaign status, timelines, deliverables and potential execution risks.
Ensure campaigns are launched according to the approved media strategy and plan.
Campaign Monitoring & Optimization
Monitor campaign performance and investment pacing throughout the campaign lifecycle.
Identify performance opportunities and work with Channel Managers and media agencies to implement optimizations.
Evaluate performance across audiences, placements, formats, creatives and other relevant media variables.
Escalate performance deviations, implementation issues or opportunities that require strategic decisions.
Support testing initiatives across audiences, creatives, formats and media tactics.



Measurement & Insights


Track campaign performance against agreed media and marketing KPIs.
Analyze results to understand what worked, what did not and why.
Go beyond media delivery metrics to identify potential connections between media performance and marketing or business outcomes.
Translate campaign results into clear insights and actionable recommendations.
Develop post-campaign analyses and consolidate learnings that can improve future campaigns.
Share relevant learnings across campaigns, markets and business units.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...

About the job

To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The MC Success Architect is a Subject Matter Expert (SME) within our Marketing Cloud product portfolio. We are looking for a passionate technical expert who has significant experience in delivering Marketing Cloud solutions to large enterprise organizations. Success Architects (SAs) are some of our most senior technical experts who provide proactive and reactive Architecture as well as Product Technical expertise. SAs deliver advisory engagements to help maximize customer success and adoption, as well as minimize attrition risk. They partner with key stakeholders at our largest, most complex customers to share their technical thought leadership and inspire the next generation of Digital Marketing Teams. This is an Individual contributor (IC) role.

Responsibilities


 Be a trusted Marketing Cloud Subject Matter Expert for the broader Success Architect organization
 Engage with our Signature and Strategic customers to evaluate and recommend optimization strategies for technical architecture, DevOps, performance, and solution design specific to Marketing Cloud
 Translate complex technical concepts for audiences ranging from Technical, Business to Executive Stakeholders
 Identify and evaluate capability gaps for standard product capability or identify creative solutions through customization
 Facilitate and influence Executive stakeholders while aligning technology strategy to business value and ROI
 Develop and run playbooks aligned with our Success Architect engagement catalog, tailored to the unique needs and opportunities of Marketing Cloud customers
 Build strong relationships with both internal and external business partners, contributing to broader goals and growth


Impact Of The Role

As a Marketing Cloud Success Architect, you will have a significant impact on our customers' success and the growth of our organization. Your expertise and guidance will directly influence the technical architecture, performance optimization, and solution design strategies for our strategic customers, ensuring their success in leveraging Marketing Cloud's powerful capabilities. By driving customer satisfaction and delivering exceptional value, you will contribute to the overall growth and reputation of Salesforce as a leader in the industry.

Collaboration And Teamwork

Collaboration is at the core of our success, and as a Marketing Cloud Success Architect, you will have the opportunity to work closely with diverse teams of professionals. You will collaborate with customers, colleagues, and partners to evaluate technical architecture, optimize performance, and design effective solutions. By fostering strong relationships and working collaboratively, you will contribute to the collective success of our teams and the achievement of our goals.

Basic Requirements


 8+ years proven experience in enterprise consulting, including implementing enterprise software solutions in the Marketing/MarTech space
 Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement (Email/Mobile) AND one of: Marketing Cloud Personalization OR Marketing Cloud Intelligence OR Marketing Cloud Account Engagement OR similar product
 Deep understanding of data modeling, integration architectures, and data governance best practices.
 Knowledge of Marketing Cloud Engagement scripting languages (AmpScript, SSJS, GTL, WSProxy)
 Experience with system architecture design and integration patterns
 Knowledge of Marketing Cloud Engagement Security capabilities and best practices
 Excellent communication skills, and ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams from Developer to Executive
 Stay up-to-date with emerging marketing, data-related and AI technologies
 Proactive and self-starting attitude with the ability to manage tasks independently while collaborating remotely with customers and colleagues
 Values the importance of Data Ethics and Privacy by ensuring that customer solutions adhere to relevant regulations and best practices in data security and privacy


Preferred Requirements


Experience implementing Salesforce Clouds, Multi-cloud scenarios - Sales, Service, Industries, Marketing or Commerce
Salesforce certifications
Familiarity with Salesforce’s technical architecture: APIs, Standard and Custom Objects, APEX
Familiar with Marketing / Personalization platforms
Familiar with AI concepts
Knowledge of Data Management principles and experience with Customer Data Platforms or Data Lakes
Understanding of development tools including SLDS, XML, HTML, SQL, Javascript, JSON, and CSS.
Other business level language skills (e.g. Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, French etc)


Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: GTM Engineer: AI-Driven Revenue Operations
description:
About the job

GTM Engineer: AI-Driven Revenue Operations

Forte Group is looking for the person who builds the AI layer under our sales engine, someone who ships automations and integrations that move pipeline faster, not someone who talks about AI adoption.

Individual contributor, with a dedicated engineer available for the harder technical builds.




Why This Role Is Different

• You're not bolting AI onto a legacy ops job. This function is being built from scratch, at an 800-person company, on a real GTM stack.

• Forte has already built a proprietary AI agent framework used across client delivery. You'll be the first to turn it inward, on our revenue engine.

• Direct line to the founder. This is a founder-sponsored initiative with a real mandate and a runway to prove it out.

• You won't build everything alone. A dedicated engineer partners with you on the heavier builds; your job is to know what to ask for and specify it precisely.




What You Will Own

AI & Sales Automation

• Design and build automations across the GTM stack: lead routing, scoring, enrichment, and outbound sequencing, using n8n, Make, Zapier, Salesforce, or custom scripts.

• Apply Forte's internal AI agent framework, or comparable LLM tooling, to real sales workflows: qualification, research, follow-up, and forecasting, with measurable impact on pipeline speed.

• Write precise technical specs and partner with a dedicated engineer on builds beyond your own hands-on ability.

• Evaluate, pilot, and kill AI and sales tools fast.




Sales Operations & Enablement

• Own the Salesforce data model, workflows, and hygiene across leads, contacts, accounts, and opportunities.

• Design and administer territories, quotas, and sales compensation in partnership with sales leadership.

• Build onboarding and ramp for new reps: system access, playbooks, and training.

• Maintain the executive view of the funnel: pipeline coverage, conversion by stage, win rates, forecast accuracy. Show up with a fix, not just a number, when leadership asks what's stalling.

• Own attribution reporting and monitor marketing-to-sales handoff SLAs.




What You Need

Must-Have

• 4+ years in sales ops, RevOps, or GTM engineering, ideally in B2B technology or services.

• Hands-on Salesforce configuration experience: fields, flows, validation rules, permissions, not just running reports.

• At least one real, shipped automation you built yourself: a Zapier, Make, or n8n workflow; a Salesforce Flow with Apex or API calls; a custom script.

• Experience applying LLM or AI agent tooling to a real workflow: prompt design, basic agent orchestration, or RAG concepts used in production, not just prompting ChatGPT for emails.

• Demonstrated ability to write precise, unambiguous technical requirements and work effectively with an engineer to get something built.

• A track record owning funnel or revenue reporting end-to-end, with a habit of finding a data problem's source instead of flagging the symptom.

• Experience with sales compensation, quotas, or territory design.

• Comfortable operating with minimal direction and high ambiguity.




Strong Plus

• Working Python fluency.

• Experience building AI agents or multi-step automations end-to-end, without an engineer's help.

• Background in technology consulting, IT staffing, or professional services.




What Success Looks Like

• 30 days: You know the GTM stack cold: where the data lives, where it breaks, and where the manual bottlenecks are.

• 60 days: One real automation is live, measurably reducing manual work or improving a funnel metric. Not a pilot deck, a shipped thing.

• 6 months: You're the person leadership asks first when they want to know what's driving or blocking the pipeline, and you already have a fix in motion.

description:
About the job

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Pro Verifications team decides whether a business signing up on the Pro side is who it says it is, and whether we're allowed to onboard it. That means figuring out who actually owns the business, running it against sanctions and watchlists, and doing all of it fast enough that a real customer doesn't lose patience and leave. Every Pro customer hits these systems, so slow or wrong is very visible — and the team is early, which means whoever joins gets to decide how a lot of it works instead of inheriting it.

How We Work


We deploy constantly, almost always behind a flag, in pieces small enough to pull back fast.
Security and compliance show up at design time, not as a gate at the end.
Every story is tied to a metric it's meant to move — if work isn't on the board, it doesn't get staffed.
At this level, you're expected to shape these standards, not just work inside them.


The opportunity

As a Staff Engineer on Pro Verifications, you'll own the technical direction for how verification is built here — the architecture, the patterns other engineers work inside, and the calls about what we own versus what we lean on a vendor for. You'll be hands-on across the stack, drive out entire classes of recurring failure rather than patching them one at a time, and design the fail-closed and audit behavior that keeps regulators satisfied.

This is a high-impact, hands-on technical leadership role for engineers who've built where being wrong has real consequences, and who want to shape a system that stays fast, safe, and defensible as it grows.


Set the shape of the verification services and their contracts across the KYC/KYB flow.
Decide how we abstract KYC and KYB vendors so a bad provider day doesn't turn into an outage.
Design fail-closed behavior and audit trails that hold up under regulatory scrutiny.
Identify the classes of failure that keep recurring and remove them for good.
Write and drive architecture decisions (ADRs), and hold the line on security and compliance at design time, not as a late gate.
Mentor and raise the bar for senior engineers through design reviews, code, and direct feedback.
Be measured on whether verification gets faster, more of it decides itself, fewer decisions are wrong, and the systems stay up — and on whether the team got stronger for you being on it.


What You Bring


Around eight years building and running production systems, with a track record of owning a domain's technical direction, not just delivering inside one.
Deep, fluent expertise in Rust, with the versatility to work across TypeScript and React where verification meets the customer.
You've set architecture other people build on, and it held up — you can point to specific classes of failure you designed out, not just incidents you fixed.
You've made teams faster through patterns, tooling, or mentoring — engineers around you got better and shipped more because of calls you made.
You've built where being wrong had real consequences: compliance, payments, security, or anywhere a bad call costs more than a rough user experience.
Strong on distributed systems, service contracts, and secure design — you've integrated third-party APIs that couldn't be trusted, with real timeouts, retries, idempotency, circuit breakers, and backup paths that actually get tested.
Comfortable with, or able to quickly ramp on, gRPC, Temporal, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, MySQL/MariaDB, Redis, and GitLab CI.


Nice to haves


Direct experience with KYC, KYB, or fraud work, including integrating providers like Trulioo, Persona, or ComplyAdvantage.
Comfort building with AI in the loop.
Time spent in crypto, fintech, or another space regulators pay close attention to.

Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.

We’re fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We’re growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.

 

POSITION SUMMARY

Join our DevelSoper Experience team to design and ship AI-native tooling and agentic workflows that meaningfully accelerate the way EarnIn engineers build, ship, and operate software, and help set a new bar for what engineering productivity looks like. This is a remote position, though it could also be a hybrid role from our Mexico City office as part of our expanding site. EarnIn offers excellent benefits for our employees, including healthcare, internet and cell phone reimbursement, a learning and development stipend, and potential opportunities to travel to our Mountain View headquarters. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

Draw on firsthand experience with the friction, toil, and frustrations that slow engineering teams down and use that empathy to build tools and automation that actually solve the right problems.
Drive the design, development, and implementation of tools, systems, and processes that accelerate engineering velocity, reduce manual effort, and raise the quality bar for software delivery.
Use the latest AI capabilities LLM APIs, agentic workflows, MCP patterns, and AI-assisted development environments to fundamentally rethink what a high-productivity engineering team looks like.
Architect and operate multi-step agentic systems with well-defined inputs, outputs, validation checkpoints, and human-in-the-loop guardrails that run reliably at scale.
Embed AI-assisted capabilities into CI/CD pipelines and GitHub Actions workflows to improve build reliability, code quality feedback loops, and developer toil reduction.
Guide and advise product engineering teams on best practices for building observable, scalable systems acting as a force multiplier across the org, not just within DevX.
Partner directly with engineering teams to identify high-friction workflows, translate them into structured AI-assisted automation, and measure impact against defined success metrics.
Instrument AI-powered features with end-to-end logging, monitoring, evaluation, and their lifecycle from pilot through iteration or retirement.
Document patterns, usage guidance, and best practices so proven workflows can be consistently adopted and extended across the org.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 

4+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years building infrastructure or internal tooling for developer teams; fluency in Python or Go.
Firsthand experience with the tools, workflows, and pain points of software engineering teams; you've felt the friction yourself and know how to fix it.
Hands-on experience building and deploying agentic or LLM-powered systems in production, including practical familiarity with MCP patterns, tool-augmented workflows, or multi-step agent architectures.
Some experience integrating with LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or equivalent) and an understanding of tradeoffs around context management, latency, cost, and safety.
Experience with GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD platforms, including building custom workflows, reusable actions, or automation that operates on code or pull requests.
Daily use of AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or equivalent); treat these as core to how you work, not a nice-to-have.
Ability to define meaningful metrics for AI-assisted tooling and run time-bound experiments to validate impact.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, comfortable advising and influencing partner engineering teams in a distributed environment.
Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, LLMs)

 

 

At EarnIn, we believe that the best way to build a financial system that works for everyday people is by hiring a team that represents our diverse community. Our team is diverse not only in background and experience but also in perspective. We celebrate our diversity and strive to create a culture of belonging. description:
About the job

Description

Gtech

Requirements

Backend Mastery (Primary)

4+ years of professional software development experience, working across both backend and frontend, with backend Java as your primary strength.

Distributed Data: Practical experience working with relational databases incluidind schema design, writing efficient queries, and participating in schema migrations.

Service Interfaces: Working experience with RESTful APIs; exposure to gRPC or Protocol Buffers is a plus.

Security: Working knowledge of OAuth2, JWT, and general web security practices (OWASP awareness).

Cloud & DevOps: Experience deploying applications on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Frontend

Angular Knowledge: Working proficiency in Angular (v18+) and TypeScript, with real experience shipping UI components to production, not only reading frontend code.

State Management: Familiarity with RxJs for handling data flow and state synchronization between backend and UI.

Testing & QualityTesting Practices: Experience writing unit tests with JUnit/Mockito on the backend, and working knowledge of Jasmine/Karma on the frontend.

Code Review Participation: Comfortable operating within a formal code review process, including external approval cycles outside the immediate team, and receiving feedback without friction.

Ways of Working

Asynchronous Communication: Able to keep work visible in writing, flagging risks and blockers ahead of time rather than reporting them after the fact, and maintaining ticket and task status current without follow-up from the manager.

Process Discipline: Consistent adherence to defined engineering processes, including complete and accurate tracking data. This is a distributed team working across time zones, so written clarity and predictable responsiveness carry as much weight as technical skill.

Autonomy: Pursues dependencies and blockers with third parties on their own initiative, and carries work from start to finish without reminders.

Job responsibilities

Core Responsibilities

Backend Development: Design and implement robust, scalable backend services using Java and Kotlin, from initial design through production deployment.

API Delivery: Build and maintain high-performance service interfaces.

Database Work: Optimize complex SQL queries, design and execute schema migrations, and ensure data consistency across relational and non-relational stores.

Hands-On Frontend Delivery: Develop responsive UI components in Angular (v18+) and TypeScript. Frontend work is a regular part of the week, not an occasional exception.

Code Review Participation: Review peers’ changes across both backend and frontend, and respond to review feedback within agreed turnaround times. Review participation is an expected part of the role and is measured.

Quality Ownership: Deliver work with test coverage in place. Verify changes through the full deployment path before declaring them complete.

Operational Communication: Keep task tracking accurate and current, raise risks early, and communicate progress asynchronously to a distributed team.

What we offer

Exciting Projects: Come take your place at the forefront of digital transformation! With clients across all industries and sectors, we offer an opportunity to work on market-defining products using the latest technologies.

Collaborative Environment:Expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!

Work-Life Balance:GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules.We offer you the best quality of work life so that you exceed the expectations of our clients, while achieving your professional and personal ambitions.

Professional Development:Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes English classes, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings. We also offer the chance to travel internationally

Excellent Benefits:We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, extended paternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.

About GlobalLogic

GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

About the job

Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd®, Slideshare®, Everand™, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise.

Culture at Scribd, Inc.

So what are we looking for in new team members? This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.

Lead Product Manager, Recommendations

In this role, you'll own Scribd's recommendations experience — helping 200 million monthly visitors discover content they didn't know they were looking for, across a corpus of 300 million documents. You'll work at the intersection of ML and product to surface the right content to the right person, at the right time.

Success means defining a compelling vision, crafting metrics that truly matter, and experimenting your way to breakthrough features that redefine discovery — in close partnership with Engineering, Analytics, Data Science, Design, and Machine Learning teams.

Communicate with clarity and influence — align product, engineering, design, content, and executive stakeholders by clearly articulating requirements, timelines, deliverables, and expected impact

8+ years of product management experience, including 4+ years leading recommendations or search products in a high-traffic consumer environment
Demonstrated success shipping ML-driven features that moved core business metrics (engagement, conversion, or revenue) at scale
Deep familiarity with retrieval and ranking algorithms, embeddings, and feature stores — paired with the ability to reason about end-to-end customer journeys for distinct user segments
Track record of thriving amid ambiguity: shaping a multi-year vision, aligning cross-functional teams, and delivering incremental wins along the way

title: Software Engineer
skills: **Position~** Senior Software Engineer

**Work arrangement~** Candidates will be required to work onsite during the first 1–2 weeks of onboarding; after this period the position is remote, with availability to work from the Mexico City office whenever needed.

**About the company~** Our client is a global provider of AI-powered legal technology, eDiscovery, digital forensics, information governance, and data recovery solutions. The organization helps law firms, corporations, and government agencies navigate complex litigation, compliance, investigation, and data management challenges through innovative technology and specialized professional services.

**About the role~** As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining mission-critical eDiscovery software used by legal teams around the world. This is a hands-on engineering position where you will own features from concept to production, leveraging modern AI development tools while maintaining high standards of quality, reliability, and accountability. The ideal candidate is passionate about building scalable software solutions, has strong experience with .NET/C# and PostgreSQL, and enjoys working in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

**Responsibilities~** Design and implement features in .NET/C# services backed by PostgreSQL and write automated tests; investigate and resolve production issues while tracing problems through the stack; use AI tooling daily for code generation, review, testing, and debugging, verifying its output before it ships; mentor junior engineers (including on responsible and effective use of AI in software development); contribute to design discussions and code reviews that keep the codebase healthy.

**Skills and experience~** 5+ years of professional software development experience in .NET/C#; solid PostgreSQL experience, including schema design and query performance; experience building and supporting scalable systems; a habit of automated testing; experience owning production systems — debugging, resolving, and learning from live incidents; daily fluency with AI development tooling, paired with the judgment to verify and take responsibility for what it produces; strong written and spoken communication, suited to distributed teams working across time zones.
**Mission~** Our mission is to bring clarity, trust, and meaning to data for clients navigating legal matters worldwide.

**Core values~** *Client is Always in the Room* — we operate and make decisions as if the client is in the room, anticipating their needs and prioritizing their best interests; *Better Every Day* — we improve our tomorrow by always striving to be better than today, embracing curiosity and questioning assumptions; *Own the Outcome* — we act with urgency, hold ourselves accountable, and maintain a bias for action; *Deliver Results Together* — we collaborate obsessively to achieve shared success, assume good intentions, debate ideas thoughtfully, treat each other with respect, and fully commit once decisions are made.
**Culture summary~** Our culture shapes our actions, our products, and the relationships we forge with our customers.

description:
About the job

The Chainalysis Deployment Strategy team helps public and private sector customers investigate financial crimes involving cryptocurrency. We combine technical knowledge with analytical rigor to support complex investigations and build regional capacity for blockchain analysis. In the LATAM and Caribbean region, our team works directly with customers to enable them in the fast-moving world of cryptocurrency investigations. Along the way, we make the world a safer place.

As a Deployment Strategist I, you will support cryptocurrency investigations, conduct research and data analysis, and help deliver training to customers across the LATAM and Caribbean region. You will learn to use Chainalysis tools and data to develop insights on illicit activity trends in crypto, and you will present findings to team members and customers. This is a growth-oriented role for someone eager to build expertise in blockchain analysis while contributing to complex financial crime investigations alongside senior team members.

In This Role, You'll


Support complex cryptocurrency investigations in collaboration with senior team members and cross-functional partners at Chainalysis
Conduct research and data analysis on financial crime cases involving cryptocurrencies, and document your findings in clear reports
Present investigative findings to team members and customers
Assist in reviewing the completeness of investigations and data collection methods to help determine the authenticity and relevance of evidence
Prepare summaries of research and analysis that highlight recommendations, follow-up leads, and potential risks to an investigation
Contribute to the development and delivery of workshops and training materials in English and Spanish
Represent the Chainalysis mission of bringing trust to blockchains with customers and partners in the region


We're Looking For Candidates Who Have


A degree in cybersecurity, criminal justice, intelligence, forensic accounting, data analytics, finance, or a related field
1-3 years of professional experience in financial crime investigations, intelligence analysis, law enforcement, compliance, or a related analytical role
Strong research skills, including experience with open-source intelligence and public or private databases
Interest in or passion for blockchain and cryptocurrency technology
Fluency in Spanish and English
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to manage multiple tasks and work both independently and as part of a team
Based in Mexico City or willing to relocate


Nice To Have Experience


Familiarity with Chainalysis products (Reactor, KYT, or similar tools)
Working proficiency in Spanish
Previous experience supporting or conducting investigations related to dark web markets, counter-terrorism financing, or sanctions evasion
Exposure to cryptocurrency exchanges, DeFi protocols, or blockchain technology in a professional setting
Relevant certifications such as CCFC (Chainalysis Cryptocurrency Fundamentals Certification), CDAF, CRC, CCI, CFE, or CAMS


AI at Chainalysis

AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

description:
About the job

Job Overview

Plan A Technologies is looking for a Lead Product Designer to own product direction and design leadership across our client engagements. This is a senior, client-facing role. You will work directly with client stakeholders to understand their business, define the product and UX direction, and design the flows and defining screens that set the standard for everything built after them.

You are the designer who can say "we can absolutely build what you're asking for, but before we commit, let me show you an approach I think solves the underlying problem better," and make the client excited to explore it.

You will work alongside UI & Visual Designers who scale your approved direction across the full product, which means your time goes where senior judgment actually matters: discovery, concepting, alignment, and quality oversight. You will typically hold direction on more than one engagement at a time, with your involvement rising and falling as each one moves through its lifecycle.

Please note: you must have at least 8+ years of product design experience, including substantial client or stakeholder-facing work, and a portfolio showing your process from problem through to shipped product is required to be considered for this role.

JOB RESPONSIBILITY


Lead discovery with client stakeholders: business goals, users, requirements, technical and design system constraints, and how success will be measured.
Define the product and UX direction, including alternative approaches the client has not asked for but should see.
Design the key flows and the defining screens and patterns that establish the direction for production.
Run workshops, present concepts, and build stakeholder confidence in the direction and in Plan A.
Challenge assumptions constructively, including client-mandated decisions, without putting the relationship at risk.
Define the validation strategy: what we test, how we test it, and what result would change the direction.
Document the agreed design direction, covering the problem, the constraints, what Plan A recommended, what the client selected, and who approved it.
Review production work for quality and drift as the UI & Visual Designer scales the direction across the product.
Monitor client sentiment and raise design risk to design leadership early, while it is still a project issue rather than an escalation.


Experience


8+ years in product design, with meaningful time spent client-facing or stakeholder-facing.
A portfolio that shows how you think, not only what you shipped: the problem, the constraints, the options you considered, and why you chose the one you chose.
Demonstrated ability to lead a room. Workshops, concept presentations, and difficult conversations with senior stakeholders.
Strong product and business judgment. You can connect a design decision to a commercial outcome and explain it to someone who is not a designer.
Strong visual design competence, and the ability to recognise and elevate exceptional craft in others. You do not need to be the strongest pure visual designer in the room, but you must know exactly what excellent looks like.
Expert-level proficiency in Figma, including components, variables and auto-layout, and comfort working inside an existing design system rather than around it.
Deep knowledge of user-centered design principles and accessibility standards (WCAG).
Experience designing within real constraints: established products, existing component libraries, technical limitations, and fixed timelines.
Excellent verbal and written English communication skills. You will be presenting to client executives.
Initiative and drive to do great things.


NICE TO HAVE


Experience in gaming, casino, or other regulated environments.
Familiarity with Material Design and Human Interface Guidelines (HIG).
Hands-on research and usability testing background.


About The Company/Benefits

Plan A Technologies is a global engineering firm created to solve the toughest tech challenges facing today’s businesses. Founded by software entrepreneurs Aron Ezra and Slav Kulik, Plan A helps organizations analyze their tech ecosystem to identify exactly what needs to be improved across their products and infrastructure—and then builds the solutions to fix it.

Rather than offering theoretical ideas or software that never launches, Plan A combines elite engineering talent with custom-built, proprietary AI agents to deliver fast, secure, production-ready solutions. Its capabilities span proprietary AI agent deployment, custom software development, application modernization, data platforms, cloud migrations, systems integration, and practical technical advice.

With more than 500 successful product deployments completed worldwide, Plan A helps organizations of every size—from ambitious startups to global enterprises—modernize their systems, automate complex operations, and stay ahead of the technology curve.

Read more about us here: www.PlanAtechnologies.com .

Location: Work From Home 100% of the time, or come in to one of our global offices. Up to you.

Great colleagues and an upbeat work environment: You'll join an excellent team of supportive engineers and project managers who work hard but don't ever compete with each other.

Benefits: Vacation, Brand New Laptop, and More: You’ll get a generous vacation schedule and other goodies.

If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!

description:
About the job

About The Role

The Consumer Product & Operations Lead for LatAm Delivery is a senior leader within the Consumer & Growth organization, responsible for defining and driving the region's product and strategic agenda to solve LatAm's most important consumer and marketplace challenges.

This role sits at the intersection of LatAm Operations and global Product & Tech teams. You will identify and prioritize the region's highest-impact opportunities, translate them into compelling product and strategic initiatives, and build the insights, business cases, and cross-functional alignment needed to influence the global product roadmap and unlock new solutions for LatAm.

You will also own the path from strategy to impact. Partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Finance, Legal, CRM, and Global and Local Operations teams, you will shape solutions, design experiments, lead launches, drive adoption, measure performance, and scale successful products, capabilities, and operating models across the region.

Your portfolio will span areas including Pricing, Promotions, XLOB/One Consumer, Affordability, in-app experience, Deliverability, and Delivery Options-covering some of the most important levers shaping the consumer experience and marketplace performance in LatAm.

You will lead a senior team of Product Champions, setting clear priorities and building a strong operating model to move the region's most important opportunities from problem identification and solution design through experimentation, launch, optimization, and scale.

What You'll Do


Set the LatAm product and strategic agenda: Identify and prioritize the region's most important consumer and marketplace opportunities, balancing consumer impact, business value, market needs, competitive dynamics, and Product & Tech constraints. 
Influence the global Product & Tech roadmap: Translate LatAm's highest-priority challenges into clear product opportunities backed by consumer insights, data, and rigorous business cases to influence global prioritization, investment, and product development. 
Lead high-impact regional initiatives: Own strategic projects that address critical consumer and marketplace opportunities, developing new solutions, operating models, and processes that can be tested, optimized, and scaled across LatAm. 
Turn complex problems into scalable solutions: Structure ambiguous consumer and marketplace challenges, identify root causes, and partner with Product, Tech, and Operations teams to design solutions that address local needs while creating regional or global scale. 
Drive products and initiatives from experimentation to scale: Define hypotheses, market selection, success metrics, and rollout strategies; ensure operational readiness; and lead experimentation, launch, adoption, measurement, iteration, and scaling. 
Lead and develop a senior Product Champion team: Set clear priorities and accountability across the portfolio while raising the bar on product thinking, analytical rigor, structured problem solving, stakeholder management, and execution. 
Build strong cross-functional partnerships: Establish trusted relationships with senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Finance, Legal, CRM, and Operations, creating effective mechanisms to connect regional insights with global product development and regional execution. 
Drive measurable consumer and business impact: Establish clear success metrics and operating cadences to assess performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and ensure product and strategic investments translate into meaningful outcomes. 
Represent LatAm in global product decisions: Bring a deep understanding of LatAm consumers, markets, and competitive dynamics into global discussions, ensuring the region's needs and opportunities are reflected in product strategy, prioritization, development, and execution. 


What You'll Need

Basic Qualifications


At least 8 years of experience in Product Operations, Strategy & Operations, Product Management, Management Consulting, Technology, or similarly fast-paced, analytical environments. 
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field. 
Professional proficiency in English and Spanish. 
Demonstrated ability to combine strategic thinking, product judgment, analytical rigor, and hands-on execution in complex and ambiguous environments. 
Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience sizing opportunities, building rigorous business cases, evaluating trade-offs, and translating data into actionable recommendations. 
Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and cross-functional teams without direct authority. 
Proven experience leading, coaching, and developing high-performing teams. 
Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate analysis, problem solving, decision-making, and operational workflows. 


Preferred Qualifications


MBA or equivalent advanced degree. 
Experience in marketplaces, delivery, logistics, mobility, e-commerce, or other real-time technology platforms. 
Strong understanding of marketplace dynamics, including the interaction between consumer demand, pricing, merchant and supply availability, incentives, and consumer experience. 
Track record of influencing product roadmaps and taking products or capabilities from problem identification and business case development through experimentation, launch, iteration, and scale. 
Experience operating across multiple countries or markets and translating local needs into regional or globally scalable solutions. 
Strong understanding of experimentation, measurement, and causal thinking, with working knowledge of SQL and data visualization tools.

description:
About the job

Fecha límite para apuntarse:

2026-10-11

¿Qué es Openpay?

Openpay es la plataforma para recepción y envío de pagos electrónicos del Grupo BBVA especializada en el desarrollo de herramientas digitales para realizar transacciones comerciales accesibles, seguras e innovadoras.

Somos el aliado estratégico de emprendedores y líderes globales.

Potenciamos la transformación digital de los negocios, somos la plataforma preferida por miles de marcas para procesar sus pagos.

¿Quieres desarrollar tu carrera profesional? 

BBVA es una empresa global con más de 160 años de historia que opera en más de 25 países en los que damos servicio a más de 80 millones de clientes. Somos más de 121.000 profesionales que trabajamos en equipos multidisciplinares y de perfiles tan diversos como financieros, expertos jurídicos, científicos de datos, desarrolladores, ingenieros o diseñadores.

¿Qué estamos buscando?

Un product manager debe tener una visión integral de un producto y considerar perspectivas legales, regulatorias, contratación, uso, operación, comercialización y de atención a clientes.

Se asegura de que las definiciones y desarrollos se hacen con carácter global y transversal para asegurar el aprovechamiento en próximos proyectos.

Gestiona el trabajo de los product owners para asegurar que la visión del negocio es conocida por todos los integrantes del equipo.

Lidera tareas e iniciativas aún en equipos que no reportan al rol y por lo tanto debe ser capaz de liderar equipos multidisciplinarios.

Para ser responsable del equipo de Multipagos, es necesario tener conocimiento en e-commerce, tarjeta presente y haber tenido experiencias previas para presentar a niveles directivos.

Debe tener capacidad de análisis para identificar problemas, plantear alternativas y presentarlas con un nivel de abstracción que permitan tener conversaciones para toma de decisiones y poder negociar cambios con los stakeholders.

Es fundamental tener habilidades de comunicación ya que los stakeholders principales son las bancas comerciales de BBVA México.

Debe saber usar Jira, google slides, google spreadsheets.

Dominio de inglés.

En caso de requerir algún ajuste razonable* en tu proceso de selección, comunícalo al reclutador/a en el primer contacto.

En BBVA creemos que contar con un equipo diverso, nos hace ser un mejor banco. Por este motivo apoyamos activamente la diversidad, la inclusión y la igualdad de oportunidades, sin importar cual sea su origen étnico o nacional, sexo, edad, religión, discapacidad, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género, la condición social, la condición de salud, las opiniones, el estado civil o cualquier otra que atente contra la dignidad humana y tenga por objeto anular o menoscabar los derechos y libertades de las personas. Estamos seguros que cultivando un ambiente de trabajo colaborativo e inclusivo podremos mostrar lo mejor de nosotros mismos.


Los ajustes razonables comprenden las modificaciones y/o adaptaciones que podrá hacer la empresa , durante tu proceso de selección, con la finalidad de que puedas llevar a cabo dicho proceso de forma adecuada.
Para el proceso Atracción de Talento se utilizan plataformas del Grupo Empresarial BBVA, del que forma parte Openpay.
