title: CRM Operations & Support Specialist
skills: Former Ivy League and Top 20 admissions officers to rigorously review and refine applications

Professors and PhD teaching fellows from leading universities to guide students through original, independent research — with pathways to selective peer-reviewed publication or conference presentation
Past ISEF winners and judges who coach students to compete for state, national, and international science fair awards
Capstone project mentors who help students design and scale leadership initiatives with real-world impact, measurable outcomes, and credible external validation

Be the users' advocate. You sit in on training sessions and working sessions and watch how people actually use the system. When a button says "Book the IC" on a deal whose IC is already booked, you notice, you understand why the user is confused, and you get it changed.

Own the feedback loop. Our US beta Slack channel gets forty posts a day: bugs, how-do-I questions, data problems, ideas. You triage every one: answer directly when you know the solution and pass on what you can't solve yourself. You keep the Salesflow feedback tracker current and make sure the backend team does not forget backend issues and the frontend team does not forget UI/UX issues.

Fix what you can, hand off what you can't. With AI as your pair, you fix copy, FAQ entries, help content and data corrections directly; small UI changes are within reach for the right person but are not the bar. For anything deeper you write a precise brief: what happened, for whom, how to reproduce it, what you already ruled out.

Own the in-app help: short videos, screenshots, and written walkthroughs, which today are generated automatically, high quality but unmonitored. You are the human who monitors changes, corrects, and adds what is missing.

Test before it ships. Before a release you click through the affected flows as a salesperson would. You keep a living checklist of the paths that matter. You are the last person who touches a feature before a user does.

Keep people unblocked. Login problems, access requests, a lead in the wrong stage, a deal that will not close. You resolve them, you write the how-to so it does not come back, and when the same question arrives three times you propose the change that makes it stop.

Grow with the rollout. As Salesflow expands to new markets and absorbs our marketing systems, the volume and variety of feedback grows with it. You build the process that scales, and you are the first person our new markets meet when they get stuck.

You have systems sense. You look at a user's screen and see the cause behind their specific issue. You ask why something was built the way it was before you decide it is wrong. You can hold a salesperson's workflow and an engineer's constraints in your head at the same time. People who have this usually come from product, implementation or solutions roles, from operations jobs where they were the one who "understood the system", or from an engineering or analytical background. Sales experience helps but is not required; we can teach you how our sales team works in a month. We cannot teach the above.

You are AI-augmented, not AI-dependent. You use Claude, ChatGPT or similar every day to do real work. You ask it critical questions, read its answers skeptically, catch it when it is wrong, and know when a task needs a human developer. If you are uncomfortable working with AI tools, this is not the role for you.

You have delivered things. Experience level matters less than evidence that you finish what you start. That could be a job in operations, support, product, or QA, or something you built yourself. Tell us about it.

You write clearly. Most of this job is written: Slack replies to users, briefs to developers, FAQ entries, AI prompts. Your English is fluent, precise, and clear. Spanish or Portuguese is a bonus for our upcoming markets.
You have drive. Nobody will hand you a ticket queue. You will see the mess, decide what matters, and go.
Experience in system design or algorithms
Experience with a CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot) as an admin or power user
Experience supporting a software product in production
Rapidly growing start up, with a flexible working environment where you will be empowered to structure how you work
Limitless development and exposure - our internal promotions/role changes made up 33% of all recruitment last year
$1000 individual training budget per year, we love to ‘Level Up’ (it’s one of our core values)!
Psychologist on staff
Insightful fireside chats and workshops to help support our high-performing and ambitious team
Radical Candor is a feedback approach we live by
We’re a global player with 28 markets (and growing) across the globe. Most roles have the option to work from one of our many offices or remotely!
description:
About the job

Crimson Education is the world’s leading college admissions consulting firm, with over 1,490 Ivy League offers and 2,410 to the US Top 15. We help ambitious students gain admission to the world’s top universities through expert-led guidance and proven, data-driven strategies. Crimson students are 7x more likely to get into the Ivy League than their peers. We were recently featured on the front page of the Wall Street Journal.

Crimson is the only college admissions consultancy that brings together:


Former Ivy League and Top 20 admissions officers to rigorously review and refine applications
Professors and PhD teaching fellows from leading universities to guide students through original, independent research — with pathways to selective peer-reviewed publication or conference presentation
Past ISEF winners and judges who coach students to compete for state, national, and international science fair awards
Capstone project mentors who help students design and scale leadership initiatives with real-world impact, measurable outcomes, and credible external validation


We’re backed by leading VC firms, including Tiger Global, Heal Partners, IceHouse Ventures, and Movac, and recently closed a USD $40M Series D funding round at a USD $640M valuation. We now operate across 21 markets worldwide, including the US, Canada, UK, Singapore, Japan, Hong Kong, Australia, and New Zealand.

The Role

Crimson is replacing Salesforce with Salesflow, an AI-native CRM we build in-house. It runs the whole sales journey: lead intake, scheduling, call transcription and coaching, AI-drafted appraisals, contracts and e-signature, and invoicing. It is live for our US sales team today and rolls out to every other market over the coming months.

The build team is four people plus AI. What we lack is the go-between: the person who breathes both sales day-to-day and the UX and can tell, quickly and correctly, whether a salesperson's issue is due to (1) the salesperson needs more guidance and training; the system is fine or (2) the salesperson is in the right; the system flow is broken / there is a bug. Often, issues are a bit of both: the salesperson has not fully understood, and the CRM has not made it obvious.

That is you. You talk to salespeople to understand what blocks them. You talk to Claude and your teammates to find out why. You answer the how-to yourself, you write the bug or design issue so an engineer can act on it without a second conversation, and specify potential alternatives. You are the reason a salesperson in Los Angeles gets an answer in ten minutes even if the developer is across the world and asleep, and the reason the same question is not asked again next week.

This is not a support desk role and it is not a QA role, though it contains both. It is not a developer role either: you will not be asked to write production code. It is the seat from which the whole feedback loop is owned.

Location: Remote from Mexico, Brazil, or Central/South America. You must be available 9:00-18:00 US Eastern.

Reporting to: Head of Data

Employment: Full time

What are the main responsibilities for this role?


Be the users' advocate. You sit in on training sessions and working sessions and watch how people actually use the system. When a button says "Book the IC" on a deal whose IC is already booked, you notice, you understand why the user is confused, and you get it changed.
Own the feedback loop. Our US beta Slack channel gets forty posts a day: bugs, how-do-I questions, data problems, ideas. You triage every one: answer directly when you know the solution and pass on what you can't solve yourself. You keep the Salesflow feedback tracker current and make sure the backend team does not forget backend issues and the frontend team does not forget UI/UX issues.
Fix what you can, hand off what you can't. With AI as your pair, you fix copy, FAQ entries, help content and data corrections directly; small UI changes are within reach for the right person but are not the bar. For anything deeper you write a precise brief: what happened, for whom, how to reproduce it, what you already ruled out.
Own the in-app help: short videos, screenshots, and written walkthroughs, which today are generated automatically, high quality but unmonitored. You are the human who monitors changes, corrects, and adds what is missing.
Test before it ships. Before a release you click through the affected flows as a salesperson would. You keep a living checklist of the paths that matter. You are the last person who touches a feature before a user does.
Keep people unblocked. Login problems, access requests, a lead in the wrong stage, a deal that will not close. You resolve them, you write the how-to so it does not come back, and when the same question arrives three times you propose the change that makes it stop.
Grow with the rollout. As Salesflow expands to new markets and absorbs our marketing systems, the volume and variety of feedback grows with it. You build the process that scales, and you are the first person our new markets meet when they get stuck.


Your first 60 days: by day 30 you own first response in our US beta channel during US hours and the feedback tracker is current. By day 60 you have shipped your first fixes, you run the weekly aging report, and login and access issues come to you and stop there.

What skills and experience are required?


You have systems sense. You look at a user's screen and see the cause behind their specific issue. You ask why something was built the way it was before you decide it is wrong. You can hold a salesperson's workflow and an engineer's constraints in your head at the same time. People who have this usually come from product, implementation or solutions roles, from operations jobs where they were the one who "understood the system", or from an engineering or analytical background. Sales experience helps but is not required; we can teach you how our sales team works in a month. We cannot teach the above.
You are AI-augmented, not AI-dependent. You use Claude, ChatGPT or similar every day to do real work. You ask it critical questions, read its answers skeptically, catch it when it is wrong, and know when a task needs a human developer. If you are uncomfortable working with AI tools, this is not the role for you.
You have delivered things. Experience level matters less than evidence that you finish what you start. That could be a job in operations, support, product, or QA, or something you built yourself. Tell us about it.
You write clearly. Most of this job is written: Slack replies to users, briefs to developers, FAQ entries, AI prompts. Your English is fluent, precise, and clear. Spanish or Portuguese is a bonus for our upcoming markets.
You have drive. Nobody will hand you a ticket queue. You will see the mess, decide what matters, and go.


Strong Plus If You Have


Experience in system design or algorithms
Experience with a CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot) as an admin or power user
Experience supporting a software product in production


This is probably not for you if you want a defined queue and a manager who prioritises it for you, if you would rather build things than make other people's things work, or if you prefer to smooth over a broken screen for a user rather than get it fixed.

Why this role

You will have a direct hand in a piece of software that replaces a global company's CRM and defines how it sells for the next decade. You will work daily with the four people who built it. There is no ceiling on what you can pick up: people who thrive in this seat grow into product, engineering or operations leadership as the team scales.

Why work for Crimson?


Rapidly growing start up, with a flexible working environment where you will be empowered to structure how you work
Limitless development and exposure - our internal promotions/role changes made up 33% of all recruitment last year
$1000 individual training budget per year, we love to ‘Level Up’ (it’s one of our core values)!
Psychologist on staff
Insightful fireside chats and workshops to help support our high-performing and ambitious team
Radical Candor is a feedback approach we live by
We’re a global player with 28 markets (and growing) across the globe. Most roles have the option to work from one of our many offices or remotely!


If you're passionate about growing in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and want to work with cutting-edge technology, then we'd love to hear from you!

Please keep an eye on your spam/junk email folder for correspondence from Team Tailor.

description:
About the job

About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

About The Role

We are looking for analytically minded and detail-oriented individuals to join the Customer Data Services team in our Mexico City office on a fixed-term basis starting at the beginning of January 2027. This role is open to early-career candidates with up to 2 years of experience who love working with complex data and want to see how it drives real decisions at the world's largest companies.

Watershed is a growth-stage start-up that works with 800+ customers globally, including 100+ of the Fortune 500 and 5 of the top 6 US banks, to accelerate their sustainability programs. You'll work hands-on with customer business data, transforming it to fit Watershed templates and enabling our customers to gain clear, reliable insights into their sustainability impact.

You will


Clean and transform customer business data into Watershed templates to reduce customer friction and drive time-to-value. 
Partner with customers to understand their raw data and recommend best practices for preparing it. 
Communicate data issues clearly to customers, covering impact, options and trade-offs. 
Leverage judgment to assess, advise, and execute on data cleaning best practices. 
Rigorously document decisions to ensure traceability of data manipulations during third-party verifications. 
Synthesize customer experiences and feedback to drive continuous improvement of our work and inform product development. 


You might be a fit if you


Have up to 2 years of experience working with large data files in Excel, whether through internships, co-ops or academic projects. Python or SQL is a plus. 
Thrive on complex, messy data and enjoy the work of making it clean, structured, and trustworthy. 
Are detail obsessed. You double check your work and do not consider something done until you know it is right. 
Have good intuition for how numbers in a spreadsheet map to the real world. You translate abstract problems into concrete data frameworks. 
Have high customer empathy and want to help them achieve their outcomes. 
Are a strong written and verbal communicator in English. You can concisely communicate externally to non-technical audiences. 
Are a low ego team player with a strong sense of ownership. You are driven by team goals and bias for action in order to achieve them. 


Fixed-term details


Minimum commitment of 4 months, with a possible extension of up to 3 additional months. 
Fixed-term employees receive compensation and benefits similar to full-time Watershed employees, including daily lunch delivered in the Watershed office in Mexico City. 
This position requires being in person in our Mexico City office 4 days per week. 


Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

title: Customer Journey Analytics
description:
About the job

skills: Organize and manage your own work across briefs, tasks, priorities, and follow-ups, without needing every next step spelled out.

description:
About the job

💸 Up to USD 28,000 salary on a full time, contractor contract

🌎 Fully remote working!

✨ Working with globally recognisable brands in US Entertainment

💻 Working with the latest hardware, tech stack and tools

🏋️ Access to benefits (country dependent 🌎 )




Who We Are 




At Storm Ideas, we supercharge the digital presence of some of the biggest names in US TV and entertainment. Since 2008, our international team has delivered bold, forward-thinking solutions for globally recognised clients.




Whether we're building innovative products, producing high-impact social content, or designing smarter ways for our partners to work—we’re right at the cutting edge of creativity, technology, and automation.




Embracing Future-Facing Technology 




Emerging technologies like Artificial Intelligence present exciting opportunities for us and our clients. As the world adapts, we’re committed to safely exploring the potential advantages of AI, integrating it thoughtfully into our work where possible, and one day guiding our clients through new possibilities when they’re open and ready for them. By tapping into our creativity, expertise, and collaboration, we aim to embrace its potential together. Our vision relies on people who are curious about this technology and excited to take on this challenge!




RESPONSIBILITIES 




Storm Ideas partners with some of the world's most recognisable media and entertainment brands. Behind that work are planning processes, approvals, asset handoffs, reporting needs, stakeholder reviews, and internal systems that need to run cleanly.




As a Creative Operations Officer, you will help teams turn messy creative and operational processes into clear workflows, systems, documentation, and handoffs. This is not a generic coordinator role. The focus is reliable delivery: understanding how work really moves, structuring it clearly, building practical Airtable and lightweight workflow solutions, and helping people use them.




You do not need to come from a social media background. You do need to be comfortable learning new domains quickly, asking good questions, and using tools and AI to make your work clearer, faster, and easier to hand over.




What can you expect? 

Organize and manage your own work across briefs, tasks, priorities, and follow-ups, without needing every next step spelled out.
Deliver work cleanly, independently, and on time, with clear status updates.
Map messy processes, identify bottlenecks, and turn ambiguous briefs into clear next steps.
Use AI responsibly to speed up workflow mapping, documentation, QA, data cleanup, and automation support, while checking outputs carefully.
Clean up creative approval workflows so teams know what is planned, what is waiting for review, what is approved, and who owns the next action.
Structure work into sensible fields, statuses, ownership, handoffs, review points, and definitions of done.
Build Airtable bases, views, and interfaces for client teams, with supporting documentation that makes the workflow easy to use.
Improve lightweight systems in tools such as Airtable, spreadsheets, project management platforms, documentation tools, Slack or Teams workflows, and automation platforms.
Create clear documentation, SOPs, interface notes, handover materials, and client-ready explanations.
QA your own work before handoff, checking data, logic, copy, statuses, permissions, assumptions, and user experience.
Present process improvements in clear, non-technical language to internal teams and client stakeholders.
Collaborate with creative, social, client service, analytics, and technical colleagues to ship practical improvements.
Support workflows after launch by gathering feedback, fixing friction points, and improving adoption.




QUALIFICATIONS 




What's important to us: 

Experience taking ownership of workflows, processes, systems, or operational projects and making them clearer or more reliable.
Strong structured thinking: you can break a messy problem into users, inputs, outputs, statuses, handoffs, risks, and decisions.
Practical AI use in real work, improving workflow efficiency and measuring success with KPIs.
Reliable ownership of defined projects, including asking clarifying questions, communicating progress, and escalating early when something is blocked.
Excellent written communication and documentation skills.
Confidence with spreadsheets, structured data, project tools, and documentation tools.
Strong no/low-code and systems aptitude. Airtable experience is highly useful, and this role will suit someone who enjoys turning a rough workflow into a clean working process.
High attention to detail and a habit of checking work before it reaches other people.
Comfortable explaining systems, process changes, and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
Adaptability and curiosity about new tools, especially where they make delivery cleaner or faster.




What’s nice to have: 

Experience with creative, content, social, campaign, approval, or asset workflows.
Experience building Airtable bases, interfaces, automations, or similar lightweight project management workflows.
Familiarity with tools such as Asana, Monday.com, Jira, Zapier, ChatGPT/Codex, Claude/Cowork, Slack, Teams, etc.
Basic familiarity with JavaScript, HTML, APIs, or scripting concepts.
Experience with change management- helping teams adopt a new process or tool without creating unnecessary complexity.




What It’s Like to Work Here




Cutting-Edge Tools & Tech

Work with the latest hardware and software so you're always set up to succeed.




Ideas Welcome, Always

We don’t just say we’re open to ideas—we act on them. Your insights can shape how we work across the company.




Fast, Agile, Adaptive

We move like a start-up but with the backing of a larger team. Quick decisions and a responsive culture are the norm.




Incredible Team, Global Reach

Join an international crew of 175+ passionate, talented people. We hire for skill, drive, and authenticity—just be yourself.




APPLICATION




Please include a cover letter with your application. It does not need to be long, but it should give us clear evidence of how you work.




In your cover letter, please briefly cover:




one example of a messy workflow, process, or system you helped make clearer, including what changed and what improved;
your experience with Airtable or similar lightweight project/workflow tools, including what you have built or improved;
one practical example of how you use AI in your work, including how you check or apply the output.




RECRUITMENT PROCESS




First, we will review your CV and cover letter for the requested examples.




If successful, you will receive a task using a provided Airtable base. We will ask you to show how you structure the workflow, build useful views or interfaces, document your decisions, and explain your approach.




If successful, you will be invited to a 60-minute interview. During the meeting, you will walk through your completed task as if presenting to a client, followed by a Q&A with Creative Operations management.




And that’s it!

description:
About the job

Establish Red Bull as a strong consumer-focused brand in México by designing and leading a short, mid and long term sports programme that builds real credibility for brand and product. Own the national sports agenda end-to-end strategy, athletes, events, gaming, partnerships and budget following the global Red Bull sports strategy while adapting global platforms into genuine local relevance. Work hand in hand with Field Marketing, Sales, Media Network and Communications to make sure Red Bull is credible inside the scenes that shape Mexican youth culture, and that this credibility converts into reach, trial and consumer growth. Be the reference of Red Bull brand values for the rest of the organization.

All the responsibilities we'll trust you with:

SPORTS STRATEGY & NATIONAL PROGRAMME

Design, develop and lead an innovative national sports and event programme, inventing and executing new event and athlete projects that are highly relevant for Mexican consumers, offer personal experiences to participants and spectators, and create unique content. Translate global sports strategy into a focused national plan, prioritising the platforms with the clearest impact on brand relevance and business growth. Maximise Red Bull's global athlete and event portfolio, bringing international athletes and platforms into locally relevant 360° plans and sending Mexican talent to global Red Bull activities. Own the department budget with full transparency — forecasting, allocation and ROI — and deliver against annual business plan figures. Run the sports department to high Red Bull standards in professionalism, cleverness, efficiency, legal, sales orientation and creativity.

COLLABORATION & DISCOVERY

Own the end-to-end connection between athletes and events in México, acting as a single point of integration across Athlete Marketing and Event Marketing rather than coordinating separate functions. Lead cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Trade, Field Marketing, Media Network, Communications and Partnerships to ensure strategic planning, flawless execution and measurable business impact. Ensure every athlete moment and event delivers value beyond the day itself, in visibility, content and consumer connection. Maintain a strong understanding of Mexican sports communities, consumer trends and emerging scenes to uncover new athletes, partnerships and growth platforms ahead of competition. Serve as a strategic thought partner across the organization, translating athletes, events and content into fewer, bigger, better-executed experiences.

ATHLETES & INFLUENCERS

Immerse yourself in Mexico's sports scenes and communities, staying one step ahead of emerging talent, trends and cultural movements. Discover, sign and grow a winning national athlete portfolio anchored in Red Bull's Core Sports, backing athletes with real cultural credibility and genuine pull with consumers. Service athletes with the best individual package — performance, marketing and communication — and continuously optimise those partnerships. Make the can impossible to miss across athlete and influencer content, and bridge athletes into creator, streamer and gaming ecosystems to reach beyond core sports audiences. Open pathways for the next generation of Mexican talent, spotting them early and building clear routes to grow inside Red Bull's athlete ecosystem. Own the definitive view of the Mexican sports landscape — athletes, teams, events, white spaces and cultural shifts — and turn it into sharper talent decisions. Turn athlete wins into cultural moments and set the bar for execution, delivering impact felt by the athlete and proven for the brand.

GAMING

Grow Red Bull's presence and relevance in gaming, one of the most important territories to connect with young consumers in México. Establish Red Bull as a credible and functional beverage across the national gaming landscape — third-party events, opinion leaders, industry, agencies, media, federations and authorities — driving daily usage and sales on a broad scale. Build a portfolio of gamers, streamers and creators with real community pull, and integrate them with athletes, events and content. Bring global gaming platforms and partnerships to life locally, and create proprietary gaming moments that connect online communities to physical experiences. Ensure consistent can and product visibility across gaming content, streams and events, and amplify the best-performing content to scale reach.

PARTNERSHIPS

Build and nurture Red Bull's network across Mexico's sports, culture and business ecosystems, so the brand has a seat at the table before opportunities go to market. Identify and engage the most fitting sports organizations — teams, leagues and federations — to expand Red Bull's presence and reach new communities. Lead partnership negotiations and guide the team towards strategic and authentic partnerships aligned with Red Bull's brand guidelines. Drive the marketing activities that bring these partnerships to life, sharing Red Bull brand values and product knowledge with partners and building strong relationships with their key stakeholders. Establish Red Bull as a functional and innovative brand within team sports by engaging athletes, trainers, opinion leaders, club partners, communities, agencies and media. Bring the right partners in: pursue partnerships that unlock real access — content, athletes, audiences and consumption environments — over passive exposure. Attract external brands, media partners and sponsors into Red Bull platforms, athletes and events, bringing in co-investment and shared budgets that extend what we can build beyond our own resources. Know the scene deeply enough to be trusted by it, understanding who moves culture, how deals get done and where competition is already positioned. Back fewer, bigger partnerships executed with excellence, and walk away from anything that does not clearly drive brand and business growth.

BRANDING & CONTENT

Unlock the full storytelling potential of every athlete, event and gaming moment alongside Media Network, Communications, Partnerships and Field Marketing — making sure the best stories travel, not just get made. Design and contribute unique stories, topics and formats for Red Bull Media House, and identify sports narratives that can be amplified across owned, earned, shared and paid channels. Own brand appearance across all national sports programmes and fields, according to international benchmarks and guidelines. Ensure information transfer in both directions via Red Bull InfoNet for all sports-related topics — athlete and event fact sheets, calendars and contacts.

PEOPLE MANAGEMENT

Recruit, develop and retain high-performing talent capable of delivering impactful Sports Marketing programmes in a lean structure where ownership is high and redundancy is low. Lead, coach and manage direct reports to deliver annual national goals, fostering accountability, ownership and a high-performance mindset — with clarity on priorities as the main driver of speed. Lead through influence as much as hierarchy, driving results through agencies, freelancers and cross-functional partners, and holding external partners to Red Bull's executional and premium standards. Supervise, direct and support Field Marketing Managers on all sports-related matters, building local capability to execute sports and athlete events to Red Bull standards across regions. Develop the team through individualized coaching, candid feedback and stretch assignments that build a real talent pipeline for México. Foster a performance-driven culture that rewards initiative, entrepreneurial spirit and executional excellence, aligned with Red Bull's values, with clear expectations and recognition of achievements.

Your areas of knowledge and expertise that matter most for this role:


Fluent in written and spoken English (second language appreciated).
4–6 years in sports or athlete marketing, preferably with an agency, brand, federation or sports property.
Demonstrated knowledge of the Mexican and global sports landscape, including key athletes, leagues, governing bodies and emerging industry trends.
Extensive network within the sports, creative and media industries.
Strong leadership, innovation, organization and team skills.
Excellent understanding of media, digital and gaming landscapes and trends.
Expertise in partnership development and management, performance, marketing and communication.
Supervision of marketing projects across strategy, communication, logistics, finance, legal and sales challenges.
Personal skills: leadership, creativity, public speaking, innovative, sporty, open-minded, confident, motivated, team-oriented, friendly, loyal, communicative, responsible, organized, stress-resistant, calm.
Proficient in PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Outlook and Adobe Creative Suite.
Educated in sports, experiential marketing or media, with work experience in the sports industry, event or marketing agency, sport institution, federation, or as a journalist. Experience in inventing and organizing sports projects.


We believe in the potential of everyone to give wiiings to people and ideas, regardless of gender expression, race, religion, affective-sexual orientation, origin, age and disability. In the world of Red Bull, everyone is welcome.

title: Account Manager Marketing Digital | $20,600-$23,600 / Mes
description:
About the job

Sueldo de $20,600 a $23,600 MXN libres de impuestos al mes, 100% remoto.




Grow Medical es una de las agencias de marketing para médicos líderes en Latinoamérica. Desde 2013 ayudamos a profesionales de la salud a atraer más pacientes con marketing digital. Hoy atendemos a más de 270 clientes en varios países de América Latina, somos un equipo de 12 personas y retenemos al 99% de nuestros clientes.




LO QUE NOS HACE DIFERENTES

- Nos enfocamos exclusivamente en el nicho de la medicina privada. Esa experiencia nos ha permitido ser líderes en este mercado.

- Nuestra cultura: empuje, compromiso, innovación, buena comunicación (escrita y hablada) y gusto por aprender.




EL PUESTO

Como Account Manager serás responsable de la relación con tu cartera de médicos. El objetivo del puesto es retener clientes y lograr que pasen de estar satisfechos a estar contentos.




QUÉ HARÁS

- Ser el punto de contacto de tus clientes por WhatsApp, correo y videollamada, con juntas de seguimiento periódicas.

- Convertir lo que pide cada médico en tareas claras (qué, quién y para cuándo) para el equipo de Google Ads, SEO, diseño y sitios web, y darles seguimiento hasta que se terminen.

- Explicar al cliente cómo van sus campañas y el retorno de su inversión. Te capacitamos para leer los números y proponer ajustes de estrategia.

- Manejar con calma a clientes molestos o impacientes y mantener expectativas realistas.

- Hacer tareas sencillas con un proceso definido, como páginas de SEO local y perfiles de Google Business Profile (te enseñamos).

- Documentar acuerdos, pendientes y fechas.




QUÉ BUSCAMOS

Indispensable:

- Experiencia atendiendo a muchos clientes a la vez, en agencia, customer success, ventas o atención a clientes.

- Experiencia con marketing digital (agencia, Google Ads, SEO, redes sociales, e-commerce o reportes de campañas), aunque sea de apoyo.

- Excelente comunicación escrita y hablada, y facilidad para explicar cosas complejas de forma sencilla.

- Extraordinaria habilidad para dar seguimiento: que puedas contarnos cómo llevas tus pendientes y fechas.

- Comodidad para tener conversaciones de negocios y videollamadas a diario.

- Atención al detalle, buena administración del tiempo y mentalidad de dueño: si algo se atora, tú lo mueves hasta cerrarlo.

- Ganas de aprender.




Suma, pero no es obligatorio:

- Experiencia en una agencia de marketing o con clientes del sector salud.

- Experiencia con herramientas de gestión de proyectos.




LO QUE OFRECEMOS

- 100% home office, de lunes a viernes, con sábado y domingo libres.

- Sueldo de $20,600 a $23,600 MXN libres de impuestos al mes, según tu perfil.

- Prestaciones de ley, incluyendo reparto de utilidades.

- Equipo de cómputo de la empresa.

- Capacitación en marketing digital y en nuestros procesos.




Los profesionales de la salud tienen una enorme necesidad de incrementar sus pacientes, y el nicho es cada vez más competitivo. Esta posición es clave para que nuestros clientes reciban resultados extraordinarios.




CÓMO APLICAR

1. Postúlate aquí en LinkedIn y responde las preguntas de preselección.

2. Si tu perfil encaja, te escribimos en un máximo de 5 días hábiles con un formulario breve (unos 15 minutos).

3. Si avanzas, tendremos una entrevista de 20 a 30 minutos.

title: Customer Experience & Conversion Operations Manager
description:
About the job

Ser parte del Tecnológico de Monterrey significa que tendrás la oportunidad de colaborar en una comunidad centrada en la educación, la innovación, la investigación y excelencia para transformar positivamente nuestro entorno. Aquí puedes potenciar tu talento y desarrollarte con un próposito trascendental: imaginar, emprender y construir soluciones que impactan positivamente a las personas y a la comunidad.

¡Esta oportunidad es para ti!

Únete al tec y transforma el futuro junto a nosotros




¿Qué harás?

El reto principal es dirigir la estrategia y operación nacional de Customer Experience y conversión durante el proceso de atracción y admisión, conectando las capacidades de Marketing, Comercial y Servicio para transformar oportunidades en solicitudes completas. Será responsable de diseñar y evolucionar un modelo multicanal, data-driven y orientado a resultados, que entregue una experiencia relevante y consistente al aspirante y su familia, reduzca fricciones e incremente la conversión en cada etapa del funnel.




¿Cómo lo harás? 

Tus principales retos serán:

• Diseñar y evolucionar la estrategia nacional de conversión, conectando Marketing, Customer Experience y operación comercial para acompañar al aspirante desde su identificación como lead hasta completar su solicitud.

• Traducir la estrategia de Marketing y Atracción en estrategias de contacto y conversión, definiendo mensajes, momentos, canales y acciones diferenciadas de acuerdo con el nivel de avance e intención del aspirante.

• Diseñar estrategias de contacto inbound y outbound de acuerdo con el comportamiento, perfil, nivel de interés y etapa del funnel de cada aspirante.• Identificar oportunidades de conversión a partir del análisis de datos, comportamiento y fricciones del journey, proponiendo acciones de Marketing, comunicación, operación y tecnología.

• Monitorear y optimizar indicadores de experiencia y negocio (conversión por etapa, avance en funnel, contacto efectivo, tiempos de respuesta, satisfacción, abandono, productividad, resolución en primer contacto y SLA), impulsando acciones de mejora continua basadas en datos.

• Liderar la optimización y automatización de journeys de conversión mediante CRM, inteligencia artificial y herramientas digitales, incrementando la personalización, oportunidad y efectividad del contacto.

• Presentar insights y recomendaciones de negocio que permitan incrementar la conversión, acelerar el avance de los aspirantes y reducir las principales fricciones que impactan su decisión.




¿Qué buscamos? 

Si tienes formación en Administración, Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería en Sistemas, Negocios, Mercadotecnia, Comunicación o áreas afines, y cuentas con experiencia de 7 a 10 años en operaciones de servicio, centros de contacto, experiencia del cliente o gestión de procesos, liderando equipos multidisciplinarios y operaciones de alto volumen, así como conocimientos en Customer Experience, CRM, plataformas omnicanal, Contact Centers, automatización, analítica, Lean/Six Sigma y planeación operativa.




Será especialmente relevante contar con experiencia en gestión de funnels de conversión, estrategias de contacto y seguimiento, modelos omnicanal y optimización de journeys, así como capacidad para conectar la estrategia de Marketing con la ejecución operativa y los resultados de negocio.

Entre tus habilidades se encuentran el liderazgo estratégico, orientación al cliente, pensamiento analítico, toma de decisiones basada en datos, excelencia operativa, gestión del cambio, planeación, colaboración transversal, comunicación ejecutiva e innovación. ¡Te estamos buscando, postúlate ya!




Ubicación: Ciudad de México o Monterrey

description:
About the job

Data Scientist Sr. — Operaciones 3PL

Ubicación: México

Área: Operaciones / Data & Analytics

Nivel: Senior

Modalidad: [Presencial / Híbrida]

Reporta a: [Director / Gerente de Operaciones / Head of Data & Analytics]




Objetivo del puesto

Buscamos un Data Scientist Sr. que combine capacidades avanzadas de análisis y ciencia de datos con una fuerte orientación hacia la operación logística 3PL multicliente, particularmente en un entorno de distribución de productos farmacéuticos para instituciones gubernamentales.




La posición será responsable de transformar grandes volúmenes de información operativa, logística y de servicio en insights accionables, modelos predictivos y herramientas de gestión que permitan mejorar el desempeño de la operación, anticipar riesgos, optimizar recursos y elevar el nivel de servicio a nuestros clientes.




Además del componente técnico, buscamos una persona con capacidad para trabajar directamente con clientes, entender sus necesidades de negocio, traducirlas a requerimientos analíticos y comunicar resultados de manera clara a perfiles operativos y ejecutivos.




Responsabilidades principales

1. Data Science aplicada a la operación

Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener modelos analíticos y predictivos aplicados a operaciones logísticas.




Analizar demanda, inventarios, niveles de servicio, productividad, capacidad, tiempos de ciclo, entregas, devoluciones, incidencias y otros indicadores críticos.




Identificar patrones, anomalías, causas raíz y oportunidades de mejora a partir de datos operativos.




Desarrollar modelos de forecasting, segmentación, optimización y detección de riesgos.




Construir indicadores y modelos que permitan anticipar desviaciones en el cumplimiento de SLA y compromisos con clientes.




Generar análisis de escenarios para apoyar decisiones de capacidad, inventario, transporte y operación.




Automatizar análisis recurrentes y procesos de generación de información.




2. Analítica para operación 3PL multicliente

Desarrollar soluciones analíticas considerando las particularidades de diferentes clientes, contratos, SLA, catálogos y modelos operativos.




Crear métricas y modelos que permitan comparar desempeño entre operaciones sin perder las particularidades de cada cliente.




Identificar oportunidades de productividad y eficiencia en almacenes, transporte y distribución.




Analizar capacidad instalada vs. demanda y detectar cuellos de botella.




Generar herramientas para seguimiento de productividad y desempeño operativo.




Apoyar la definición de KPIs operativos, financieros y de nivel de servicio.




Detectar desviaciones y proponer acciones correctivas basadas en evidencia.




3. Orientación a clientes

Trabajar directamente con clientes para entender problemas de negocio y traducirlos en soluciones basadas en datos.




Participar en reuniones de seguimiento operativo y de desempeño.




Preparar análisis, presentaciones y business reviews para clientes.




Explicar resultados analíticos de forma clara para audiencias no técnicas.




Convertir requerimientos de clientes en hipótesis, análisis, modelos y entregables concretos.




Dar seguimiento a compromisos derivados de análisis y recomendaciones.




Identificar proactivamente oportunidades de mejora para los clientes a partir de los datos de operación.




Fungir como puente entre clientes, operación, tecnología y equipos de analytics.




4. Gestión y calidad de datos

Trabajar con fuentes de datos provenientes de WMS, TMS, ERP, sistemas de inventarios, transporte, pedidos, entregas y plataformas de clientes.




Integrar y transformar información de múltiples fuentes.




Validar consistencia, calidad e integridad de los datos.




Identificar problemas de captura, homologación y trazabilidad.




Establecer reglas y controles para asegurar la confiabilidad de los indicadores.

About the job

About Us

At WeWork, we provide flexible workspace solutions to help businesses of all sizes thrive in more than 37 countries worldwide. The future of work is here, and we’re not just a part of that movement—we’re leading it. United by a desire to build a global community, our purpose is to give members the support to do their best work, and the space to take their ideas to new heights. Join us as we empower tomorrow’s world at work.

About The Opportunity

Become the Heart of Our Community; Empowering Life's Work

Our Community team isn't just a part of the business—it is the driving force behind our members' success. We are dedicated to enabling every member to create their life's work, and as a Community Lead, you will be leading that effort.

In this role, you are responsible for ensuring your building meets our global standards for hospitality and operating excellence. Whether supporting a diverse member base or a key Enterprise client, you will serve as a trusted and reliable leader focused on member satisfaction, operational excellence, and business performance.

Hospitality & Member Engagement

This is an on-site position in WeWork Varsovia, with a requirement to be in the buildings 5 days per week per week. In this role, your work will include but not be limited to the duties listed below: 


Deliver elevated hospitality by anticipating member and guest needs, offering personalized support, and ensuring a positive experience throughout all stages of the member journey.
Act as the primary point of resolution for member feedback, leveraging NPS data to identify trends, solve complex escalations with empathy and accountability, and implement proactive service improvements.
Support the Community Team in execution of a curated community event strategy that fosters professional networking and member connections, directly impacting member retention and satisfaction metrics.
Support the Community desk schedule as needed, ensuring there is consistent coverage during business hours. 


Building Operations


Serve as the on-site Lead owning the operation excellence and standards of your building, identifying and implementing improvements that enhance the space on a daily basis.
Ensure timely resolution, clear communication, and consistent execution on all service requests, monthly move-in/ move-out processes, and maintenance work orders, partnering with internal and external stakeholders. 
Partner with our Security team to be the on-site representative for all safety and security protocols and ensure the building remains compliant with global health and safety standards.
Manage the location’s controllable operating costs, while delivering a premium experience for our members


Revenue Growth And Sales Support


Partner with the Leasing team to lead high-impact tours for prospective members, sharing benefits tailored to their unique business needs to capture new revenue and drive building occupancy.
Drive building financial success by proactively pursuing revenue growth opportunities, such as ancillary service sales and membership upgrades.
Collaborate with members to pinpoint renewal and expansion possibilities through the use of data-informed analytics


About You

We’d love to hear from you if you meet the qualifications below:


Bachelor’s Degree in Hospitality or Tourism
Proficient in English 
Preferred 3+ years of professional experience and proven track record of success in hospitality, multi unit retail or related experience.
A proactive problem-solver with an entrepreneurial mindset who embraces change and is committed to continuous professional growth.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a natural ability to build rapport with diverse stakeholders ranging from entrepreneurs to Enterprise executives.
Experience utilizing data (such as Qualtrics or CRM tools like Salesforce) to inform decision-making and drive member satisfaction.
Embraces challenges in a fast-paced environment. Strategic thinker and problem solver with an entrepreneurial mindset. 
Exhibit a high degree of accountability and a strong work ethic, while maintaining compassion and self-awareness in all professional interactions.


Life at WeWork

Being a WeWorker is more than just a job. We believe the magic of work is sparked by the passion you bring, the places you go, the people you meet and the purpose you follow. And it starts here. Here you will brush shoulders with those who dare to dream and do. Here you will be welcomed by a community that embraces and inspires you—because together we can achieve more. Here we challenge ideas, and explore new ways of getting things done. Whether you are part of our Employee Community Groups, or part of a global project, we ask you to bring your open-minded attitude and collaborative spirit. In return, you will be part of a team where your unique perspectives are celebrated.

description:
About the job

Remote (Mexico) · Full-time contractor · $15K base + $15K target bonus ($30K USD OTE), uncapped · Start ASAP




Be the first call that changes what a home can earn

Most homeowners have no idea what their house could earn as a short-term rental. You're the one who tells them. Every owner you bring in becomes a home our team designs, launches and runs, and a bigger paycheck for you.




This seat is the front door of our growth. You'll work directly with one of our co-founders, and what you do on the phones shows up in our numbers within weeks.




Why HomeHop

We're one of the largest short-term rental operators in Ohio: roughly 140 homes across Cleveland, Akron, Columbus, Cincinnati, Pittsburgh and Indianapolis, with new markets ahead. We've launched two investment funds and are planning a third. And we don't do beige. Our homes are the ones with the pickleball court, the hot tub and the game room, the listings people screenshot.




A team that moves fast: we're a lean, tech-forward crew that tries new tools the week they come out, and turns a good idea into a new process in days, not quarters
AI is how we work: you'll use Claude/Grokbot/ChatGPT every day, and we want your ideas on what to automate next
Growing fast: four years in, 25+ full-time team members, and more homes every month
You won't be the only one in Mexico: a large share of our team works remotely from Mexico across operations and guest experience
A direct line to leadership: you work day to day with a co-founder, not three layers down, and your wins get noticed
The role

This is a phone-first, high-volume outreach role. You set the meetings; our Chief Growth Officer runs them and closes. Your scoreboard is simple: qualified meetings held, and owners who sign and go live.




What you'll do




Call homeowners in our markets every day, working from lead lists we provide (target: 100+ dials a day once ramped)
Open with confidence, explain the HomeHop model in plain language, and handle objections
Qualify every lead before you book it: the owner is the decision-maker, the home is in one of our markets, and short-term rentals are allowed there
Book qualified meetings on our Chief Growth Officer's calendar and make sure the owner shows up
Follow up with warm leads until they're ready, so nothing goes cold
Log every call, outcome and next step in our CRM, the same day
Report weekly on dials, connects, meetings held, owners signed and owners live
Bring back what you hear on the phones so we keep sharpening the pitch together




We give you the script, objection guide, market training and lead lists, built from our Chief Growth Officer's own calls. You bring the discipline, the volume and the rapport.




Who you are
Fluent, professional English. It doesn't need to be your first language, but you should be fully at ease carrying a natural, persuasive conversation with US homeowners. That's the heart of this job.
2+ years of outbound phone work (cold calling, appointment setting or inside sales), ideally calling US customers
Motivated by commission and steady through rejection. You show up the same on a bad day as a good one
Organized follow-up. You work a pipeline, not a pile of sticky notes
Self-managed and reliable in a remote setup: on time, every workday, without being chased
Curious about AI. We use Claude across the business and want you using it to prep calls, write follow-ups and keep your CRM clean
Legally able to work in Mexico, with a quiet workspace, a quality headset and stable internet




Nice to have: real estate, property management, home services or short-term rental experience; hands-on CRM experience.




Compensation

$15,000 base + $15,000 target bonus = $30,000 USD on-target earnings, and the bonus is uncapped. It's paid on the meetings you set and the owners you bring on, so top performers earn well past $30K. We'll walk through the full plan together when you join.




The details
Engagement: full-time independent contractor (consulting agreement), not an employee position. You invoice HomeHop monthly
Schedule: about 40 hours a week, Monday–Friday, aligned to US Eastern hours (some late-afternoon Eastern time, when homeowners pick up)
Location: 100% remote, based in Mexico
Tools: we provide the CRM, lead lists and calling setup. You provide a reliable computer, headset and internet
Home office stipend: up to $500 for actual home office costs, paid three months after your start date, against receipts
Who you'll work with: our Chief Growth Officer day to day, plus our onboarding team, who take each owner you sign from contract to live listing
Growth: prove the funnel and this grows into running your own meetings and closes, or leading a small outreach team
Start date: as soon as possible




HomeHop is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on the work.
